findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_enquiry_form, prepare_enquiry, record_property_event, open_shortlist, inspect_travel_video · Private data: get_stay_estimate, get_stay_quote, get_property, get_enquiry_form, prepare_enquiry, submit_enquiry, record_property_event, inspect_travel_video · Public sink: get_stay_quote, get_enquiry_form, prepare_enquiry, submit_enquiry, record_property_event, inspect_travel_video · Destructive: search_properties.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_enquiry_form, prepare_enquiry, record_property_event, open_shortlist, inspect_travel_video · Private data: get_stay_estimate, get_stay_quote, get_property, get_enquiry_form, prepare_enquiry, submit_enquiry, record_property_event, inspect_travel_video · Public sink: get_stay_quote, get_enquiry_form, prepare_enquiry, submit_enquiry, record_property_event, inspect_travel_video · Destructive: search_properties

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
